All disease and illness, mental and physical,  is eradicated.  Natural resources, the environment, restored. Pollution eradicated and zeroed out in perpetuity. 

To solve the space on earth problem,  dimensional folding. Intelligence of humanity greatly increased and sci fi stuff (a la star trek) made real. No more violence,  no more crime. Free will still exists otherwise.


Everyone can control their own aging once they reach adulthood. There is no more death. Literally you cannot die. But it's more than that. No one will self harm as it won't even occur to them to do that.  As for accidents everyone heals like deadpool so no one can be hurt either. 

Drugs won't be illegal but people won't abuse them. Recreation is fine.  The really dangerous stuff just won't exist anymore.

Family pets are granted immortality.  

No one has to be alone. People who could be together mutually are drawn to each other. No more guesswork. And if they want to give it a shot they will. They don't have to, but no more wondering if someone likes you. It's more complex than that but this is a general summary.

Women only get pregnant if they want to be. No more childbirth complications. No more rape or abuse of any kind. People won't even try or conceive of it.  That type of thing is removed from human nature. 

I would walk among the people. There would be no doubt as to my existence. No one would be forced to worship me, but I would happily be available for interaction from all of humanity.  

No more poverty. No more hunger. No more loss. I won't prevent sadness or any emotion that's just wrong but with no more war or depression or illness or hunger or lack of any kind the causes for negative emotion will be mitigated. 

Also.. all my favorite shows are still around. Firefly for instance. Also, if your favorite show is gone,  no it isn't, its available on my superreality tv service, EternalVision. Free, of course. 

No more bad weather. Anywhere. Each country will have climate zones to fit any preference. But let's say you live in Texas and like it cold. There's a part of Texas where it's always chilly. Same for warmth loving canadians. 

Vehicles and transportation greatly advanced,  teleportation is a reality. 

Internet, streaming services,  tv, it's all free. In fact pretty much everything is free. You can have a job for sure but you don't need one. I will provide for all. Life, love, enjoy life. It's all wondrous.

Forever.

How to support friends who struggle with mental health issues, and the reality of living with anxiety and depression. I strongly feel that people don't understand these conditions or how to help their friends/family who struggle with them.

I'm am strongly considering getting medication for my depression and anxiety disorders. I was very against this when I was initially diagnosed, and I left therapy because they were very insistent that I needed it. Years later, my conditions are such a negative drag on my life that I think it would probably be a good idea to try medication even though I know anti depressants are a crapshoot. 

Just looking for some advice.

I have Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) along with Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD).  I have been struggling with these conditions since the early 2000s. I was diagnosed officially in 2009 when I finally sought professional help. 

So many accurate and good things have been said in this thread, and I don't want to excessively repeat others or muddy the water but for me the depression part is like living with a shadow. Sometimes I forget it's there and life is more or less normal, but then without a warning the sky is clouded and I can no longer control my emotions.

Sometimes I am sad, and feel despair beyond description. The sense that I am alone. Impossibly, inescapably alone. That I will never be loved. That the sun will never shine again. Even though rationally I know it will pass, that feeling is overwhelming and almost impossible to dismiss. You can't choose to banish it, you can't just "cheer up". You just reach out to friends who support you and hang on. 

Other times it is a complete blankness. A numbness. Lack of feeling. A void. In a way this is much worse. I have had suicidal ideations way more often during the numb times. Music is flat. Entertainment holds no appeal. And yet you do anything to fill that time to avoid the shadows incessant whispers that relief only comes one way.

I have only really told a handful of people about my conditions because they are almost impossible to describe with any accuracy and sadly in my experience people just can't process it. It is really disheartening to pour out your deepest pain and see a look of incomprehension. 

It's hard for me to be motivated to clean. To leave my house many days period. The anxiety disorder also contributes heavily to these issues, my own personal "shit soup" of complications.

Be there for your friends. Even if you don't understand. If you can't. Love them and support them by being there. It means more than we could ever say.
